slides.h: Most people won’t get in. That’s the point.
slides.p: A private community for plans that actually happen. Apply, and we pick.

slides.h: How to get into The Semi Circle
slides.p: Four steps. One of them is turning up.
It takes about two minutes. Tell us who you are and where in NCR you live.
Not an algorithm. Not a form that auto approves. Someone actually reads it.
If it’s a fit, you get an email and the app opens up. If not, we say so kindly.
Join a plan. Padel, cafes, quiz nights, treks. That’s the whole idea.
Said from the bed. Said with full confidence.

slides.h: 11 pm: “We should do something this weekend.”
slides.p: Saturday: seen by everyone. Replied to by no one.
That’s it. That’s the rule. Everything else is built around it.

slides.h: A plan is only as good as the people who come.
slides.p: A cafe table for six with three people turns into an awkward lunch.

slides.h: We quietly keep a reliability score.
